target.statement: Few-shot binary classification F1-score (or accuracy) of the proposed triplet network + KNN on CICIDS2017 with 10 malicious samples per class, as reported in the main binary comparison table.

compute.basis: Small tabular MLP triplet network on ~275k rows trains in minutes on CPU, but the full protocol (5 repeated evaluations, random hyperparameter search over lr/batch/embedding dim/margin, plus baseline re-implementations) and data download/preprocessing push command time to a few hours; no GPU needed.

blockers: Full hyperparameter search and 5-repeat protocol must be re-run to match the exact reported number
Repo may not include exact configs/seeds for the specific table cell
CICIDS2017 requires downloading and re-extracting 28 flow features from PCAPs
title: Few-Shot Network Intrusion Detection Using Online Triplet Mining
